purpose: One independent centerline-normal lattice method family: can it produce one geometry-qualified reference candidate on the already exposed first485 map? No time optimization or new condition. Multiple representation/search changes are intentional, not a one-factor causal claim.

input.split: Already exposed first485 DEV; identity/history unchanged. No independent-DEV count.
input.missing_input: Technical stop. Never reset, rematerialize, replace or choose another condition.

representation.stations: Original geometry(snapshot) center_i/normal_i in source road-index order; do not optimize/reorder/add stations.
representation.source_arc: Original centerline basis() arc_s and L=sum(centerline edge lengths), used only as fixed taper labels. Not arc length of the new path.
representation.source_taper: tau_i is original sampled smoothstep(min(min(s_i,L-s_i)/10,1)). No B16 coefficient vector is required.
representation.point: Serialize float64 p_i(q)=c_i+n_i*(tau_i*q), then deduplicate by actual full point float64 bits; first canonical rank wins. p0,p1,p_last are copied directly from original serialized center bytes, not recomputed c+n*0; discard aliases there.
representation.seam: Output M=N distinct station entries, no appended duplicate closure point. The closing edge is p_last to p0 and its source-arc labels are s_last to L.
representation.postprocess: None: no smoothing, resampling, decimation, waypoint shortcut or serialization rounding after certification. Every consumed geometry byte must match the certified final polyline.

offset_certificate.source_gate: Unchanged station scalar-offset bound B, obstacle inflation and aggregate source free_feasible acceptance. The new continuous tube certificate is an explicitly stronger construction requirement.
offset_certificate.reference_taper: Analytic smoothstep tau_ref(s) with frozen source float64 s_i,L treated as exact rational constants, on unwrapped [0,L]. It is unimodal, so its minimum on each edge label interval is min(endpoint values), including across midlap.
offset_certificate.exact_arithmetic: Use Fraction.from_float for B, each c coordinate, each serialized p coordinate, s_i and L. Form u=Fraction(p)-Fraction(c); NEVER Fraction(p-c) after a rounded float subtraction. Square/sum exactly; do not assume stored normal has exact unit norm.
offset_certificate.edge_rule: Let tmin_i=min(tau_ref(s_i),tau_ref(s_{i+1})), with s_N=L. Require ||u_i||² and ||u_{i+1}||² <= (B*tmin_i)². Precompute node eligibility using the smaller bound from both incident edges.
offset_certificate.proof: For actual straight segment P(t) and center chord C(t), P-C=(1-t)u_i+t*u_next. Convexity of norm gives ||P-C||<=B*tmin_i<=B*tau_ref(s). This is a Euclidean tube bound, not an offset times rotating-normal identity or actual road-body containment.
offset_certificate.boundary: tau_ref(0)=tau_ref(L)=0 forces p1 and p_last onto their center bytes, as well as p0. This conservative sufficient rule removes a free first-successor root index and simplifies the closed-cycle DP.
offset_certificate.rounding: Any exact-certificate failure removes that node/edge; no epsilon correction or tolerance relaxation. Sampled and analytic taper rounding differences are not silently equated.

graph.states: Layer i stores ordered pair (rank at i-1,rank at i); exact pair geometry carries incoming heading. No angle quantization or one-side initial homotopy.
graph.initial: Single pair (p0=center0,p1=center1), validated first edge. If source arc order/schema is invalid, stop technical.
graph.transition: For each layer i=2..N-1 and eligible a,b,c: require complete edge p_(i-1)^b to p_i^c valid and original three-point curvature at p_(i-1)^b within target. Reachable (a,b) may enter (b,c). Both normal-offset signs remain available.
graph.edge_predicate: Positive finite edge length; closest point over the ENTIRE edge against ALL six physical obstacles using original radius+2.9+0.25; source clearance>=0 for this sufficient subgraph; continuous offset certificate above. No endpoint-only shortcut.
graph.triple_predicate: Original curvature() expression 2cross/max(norm(a)*norm(b)*norm(a+b),1e-9), exact source float64 operation order, abs(kappa)<=tan(0.4)/3.24. Additionally require incoming_edge dot outgoing_edge>0 with no epsilon, preventing collinear reversals hidden by the curvature denominator floor. These are strict sufficient construction predicates; not a claim of exhausting the looser original aggregate-tolerance gate.
graph.finish: After reaching N-1, validate closing edge, triple (p_(N-2),p_last,p0) and seam triple (p_last,p0,p1). Apply the same complete triple predicate, including positive dot, to last and root vertices. All N curvature vertices and N edges are certified.
graph.search: One layered reachability DP, not Dijkstra/time optimization. No score or estimated lap time. Store lowest canonical predecessor rank for each reachable pair.
graph.ties: Station order then q canonical rank. Within a target pair choose smallest predecessor rank; at finish choose lexicographically smallest terminal pair with both seam checks. Reconstruct exactly one path, no other-goal retry.
graph.finite_completeness: Completed DP exhausts only the registered conservative local-predicate graph. Pair merging is valid for these local constraints and fixed boundary points. It does not prove continuous/physical infeasibility or completeness for nonlocal executor restrictions.

independent_gate.implementation: Separate source checker, not the search predicates or cached feasibility flags. Independently reconstruct center/normals/source arc; authenticate snapshot and every final point/offset/rank and byte hash.
independent_gate.source_functions: Pin original geometry(), obstacle_clearance(), curvature(), B/taper definitions. Candidate offset array replaces B16 offset output while retaining the same numerical source free_feasible formula.
independent_gate.final_original_acceptance: Recompute all six full-polyline segment clearances, all N source curvature values including seam, all station offset residuals and V=sum(negative_clearance²)+100*sum(curvature_excess²)+sum(offset_excess²). Require minclear>=-1e-6 and V<=1e-8, unchanged. Also require the stronger registered continuous tube certificate.
independent_gate.evidence: Audit node eligibility, edge masks, packed triple masks, layer reachability/predecessors and final closed-route certificate. An independent source algebra audit recomputes predicates; it does not select a second route.
independent_gate.interpolation: The final representation IS these straight edges; every edge is checked continuously for obstacles and tube offset, every corner for the original three-point curvature proxy. Polyline corners do not have finite classical C2 curvature. No stronger continuous steering/dynamic certificate is claimed.
independent_gate.future_changes: Any later interpolation/rounding/resampling/smoothing creates a new artifact and invalidates this certificate until every final edge/corner/offset/seam is independently recertified under a separately registered method. No silent postprocessing.

executor_boundary.source_inspection: Existing executor consumes line(M,2), ds(M), speed(M+1), model; it does not consume B16 coefficients. Lattice polyline is representable, but this search produces geometry only.
executor_boundary.schema: Finite exact line bytes, ds>0, no duplicated closure vertex; closed seam and start/finish point fixed. Any later ds/kappa/speed/pace/P4 must be rebuilt from this exact final line, never borrowed from485.
executor_boundary.compatibility_check: Inspect final polyline for duplicate points, adjacent backtracking and nonadjacent intersections/overlaps and on-reference canonical projection ambiguity. Existing cursor window and off-reference nearest projections remain unqualified; no all-pose tracking guarantee.
executor_boundary.nonlocal_limit: A first returned goal failing nonlocal compatibility does not prove the graph has no compatible path: earlier prefix merging can lose alternatives. Stop without another goal or state enrichment.
not_part_of_this_test: No speed profile or estimated time objective
executor_boundary.promotion: Geometry-qualified candidate with explicit compatibility result only. Complete executor input, speed law and native/source fidelity remain separate future gates, not automatic follow-up.

resources: Limits cover imports, static/source/input checks, rational certificates, dedup, all graph predicates and DP, one reconstruction, independent source audit, compatibility check, serialization and full readbacks. Charge work before each batch. Stream K^3 predicates per layer; do not materialize N*K^3 float arrays. 60/90 is a hard cap, not a benchmark or completion guarantee.
records: Retain q/point/dedup and rational-certificate witnesses privately; full edge-min-clearance masks and hashes, packed triple-valid bits, every layer reachability/predecessor table and work counts; selected path and full final certificate. Split arrays into bounded files with declared shapes/dtypes/padding. Source audit can reconstruct all predicates. All files+code+publication+temp use one global quota with pre-reserved companion artifacts/termination capacity; no old raw copy or deletion.
prerequisites: Explicit later authorization;488 is static design only. Register exact implementation, source/runtime and inputs before any grid generation.

Zero-search fixtures: both bypass signs, interior segment collision, curvature requiring incoming edge, duplicate/bit signed-zero handling, taper rounding and midpoint fold, closing edge/last/root curvature, predecessor ties and nonlocal-compatibility limits.
Verify full frozen first485 input present, current deadline/protected/main/Participants/backup pins, fresh CPU/RSS/file/temp/disk quotas and interruption-safe stop journal.
Independent predicate/checker implementation must be tested on synthetic fixtures before map search; reject cache/source disagreement as technical, never widen a tolerance.

decisions.success: Exactly one returned path passes independent original source geometry gate plus continuous tube certificate. Publish geometry-candidate status and a separate executor-compatibility status; do not promote speed/tracking/native/pixel or claim safety beyond these geometric predicates.
decisions.finite_reject: Completed exhaustive DP has no goal: this fixed conservative lattice method is insufficient on this exposed map. This is not nonexistence in the original tolerance-allowed graph, another grid, continuous path space or physical simulator.
decisions.compatibility_failure: Graph path is geometry-qualified but nonlocal/schema check fails: executor compatibility not qualified. No alternative-goal retry; do not label the entire graph/continuous geometry infeasible.
decisions.inconclusive: Partial search due CPU/RSS/disk/work/file/deadline cap, missing input, numerical/schema/source disagreement or interrupted audit. Preserve charged work and stop; no resolution/representation/cap change or retry.

privacy: Coordinates, seed, condition identity, masks/path/raw and private documents remain private. Publish method, fixed counts, aggregate result and source code only.
